# Vendor onboarding photo

`vendor.jpg` (954×1536): the Figma vendor onboarding photo (woman carrying a woven basket) with the design's green tint
baked in (rgb(0, 74, 38) at 70%, matched to the Figma render). The "Go Green With Us" text is drawn by the page
(`src/components/OnboardingShell.tsx`), so it is not in the image.

To replace it, export the photo with its tint but without the text, ideally at 2x (about 1270×2050).
